BiblicalUsage: Bohan means thumb, and he is a Reubenite who set a boundary stone between Judah and Benjamin. In Joshua 15:6 the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben, and in Joshua 18:17 the boundary descended to the same stone. A man remembered only by the stone that bears his name — a mark of division between two tribes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stone of Bohan is a small picture of God's order: even a boundary stone gets a name, and the tribes knew where they stood.
